text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон finishes first in her debut
race,
managing to secure center stage in
a magnificent
winning concert.

Discovering the joy of standing center
stage only
strengthens her resolve to
become a top Umadol.

To get to the top, she'll need to build
her fanbase
by running and performing
as much as possible.

We set our sights on winning at least two
races at
the Pre-Open level или выше
during junior year to
jump-start her
fame.
